item.description:

Spot and CEX futures both fell in October, while perpetual DEX volume climbed 6% to $659B.

The drop in centralised-exchange activity lined up with a fall in Bitcoin following a reported $6.3B Binance hack.

Among perp DEXs, the month’s standout was Variational, which climbed to $78B to rank second for the first time, overtaking every challenger behind Hyperliquid.
